{{Quote|You have faced the ''balyeg''. You need ''never fear again''.|Jango Fett, to his son Boba|<ref name="BT1" />}}
The '''balyeg''' was a large [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] creature that preyed on the [[pardlam]]. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] considered it one of the scariest creatures in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Hoping to teach his son [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]] not to fear, Fett took him to the balyeg's [[Unidentified planet (balyeg)|planet]] and ordered him to get the creature's tooth. Boba was successful in this task.<ref name="BT1" />

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|This is the tooth of a balyeg. It's still coated with some of the beast's venom. You know of the ''agony'' this venom causes?|Boba Fett, to [[Mac Ewevs]]|<ref name="BFiD3">[[Blood Ties: Boba Fett is Dead 3|''Blood Ties: Boba Fett is Dead'' 3]]</ref>}}
The balyeg was a gigantic [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] creature that inhabited on a [[Unidentified planet (balyeg)|planet]]. The balyeg had [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], large claws and [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], and a series of bony ridges covered its body. This characteristics combined to give the balyeg a frightening appearance.<ref name="BT1" />

==Behavior==
{{Quote|You know those large creatures we saw on the way in? The ''pardlam''?''"<br />"''They were hard to miss.''"<br />"''They're the main food source of the ''balyeg''. The pardlam are the only things on this planet big enough to sate its hunger, and it needs to eat a lot of them.|Jango and Boba Fett|<ref name="BT1" />}}
The balyeg lived in a large cave and preyed on the [[pardlam]], which were the only creatures large enough to satisfy the balyeg's hunger. The balyeg located the pardlam by a special smell that they emanated.<ref name="BT1" />

==History==
{{Quote|You have faced the most terrifying thing in the galaxy. Now, no matter how long you live, no matter what you come up against&mdash;you know the ''most fearful thing'' you will ever face is behind you.|Jango Fett, to Boba|<ref name="BT1" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the balyeg's planet of residence was visited by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and his son, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]]. Hoping to show his son the most frightening creature in the galaxy so he would never fear again, Jango took Boba to the balyeg's cave. Spraying him with the pardlam's smell, Jango gave Boba his [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and told him to bring the balyeg's tooth to him. The balyeg attacked Boba, but the latter was able to maneuver on the jetpack and take the creature's tooth, bringing it back to Jango.<ref name="BT1" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Breath of the Balyeg]]'' participated in the [[Battle of Shramar|battle]] of [[Shramar]].<ref name="Revelation 3">[[Invasion: Revelations 3|''Invasion: Revelations'' 3]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The balyeg first appeared in [[Blood Ties 1|''Blood Ties'' 1]].
